properties.name: tandem.relay.enabled
properties.description: Whether this application runs a relay. Set to false to load the module without starting one — the supported way to deploy a single image both as a write-side service and as a dedicated relay process. Gates the whole autoconfiguration, so it binds to no configuration-properties type and the annotation processor cannot see it.

properties.name: tandem.kafka.producer
properties.description: Raw Kafka producer properties, passed through to the producer the relay publishes with (e.g. bootstrap.servers, security and compression settings). Tandem hardens the values that protect the no-loss and ordering guarantees — enable.idempotence, acks, max.in.flight.requests.per.connection — and rejects unsafe overrides at startup.

values.description: Comma-separated host:port list of brokers. Required in practice — the relay cannot publish without it.
Compression for produced batches: none (default), gzip, snappy, lz4, zstd.
How long the producer waits to batch records. Raising it raises the filled-in delivery.timeout.ms with it, which must stay below tandem.relay.row-lease.
Maximum bytes batched per partition before a send.
Total time a send may take before it fails. Must stay below tandem.relay.row-lease — the relay validates the invariant against this effective value at startup.
Per-request broker timeout. Counts towards the minimum delivery.timeout.ms Kafka accepts.
SASL mechanism when security.protocol selects SASL (e.g. PLAIN, SCRAM-SHA-512).
